items.text: Studied about four years under José Luzán, Zaragoza, from about age 14
Studied with Anton Raphael Mengs, Madrid
Submission denied entry to the Real Academia de Bellas Artes de San Fernando, Madrid
Second submission denied entry to the Real Academia de Bellas Artes de San Fernando
Studied with Francisco Bayeu y Subías, Zaragoza; traveled to Rome at his own expense after failing to win a scholarship
Second prize, painting competition of the City of Parma
Member of the Real Academia de Bellas Artes de San Fernando, Madrid
Salaried painter to Charles III
Court painter to Charles IV
First Court Painter
Director of the Royal Academy
Primer Pintor de Cámara (Prime Court Painter), the highest rank for a Spanish court painter
